name: Work ledger
notes: A thread's Work tab and the Details drawer

features.feature: The Work tab has saved views (Board, Tree, + New view; rename, duplicate, delete), remembered per thread

The bar filters by layout, kind (with counts), owner (Anyone, Nobody named, the user once as "Me (name)" whichever name their items carry, each other name) and Open only (Owner and Kind narrow every board column, Done included; Open only leaves Done alone); on a board Group by (none, story, owner) and Fields ▾
The sync line says Not synced yet / Synced HH:MM / Reading… / Sync failed, how many calls wait to be read and how many items wait for review

The board's columns (To do, In progress, Waiting, Blocked, Done) hold tasks and questions; a card shows id, story, owner avatar (client-owed marked), title, kind, due (late in red, by the local date), waiting on (not once done), holds up, last call
Dragging a card to another column sets its state as the user's edit (undoable); Waiting takes no drop

A column's menu renames, recolours, sets its state and limit (over the limit shows), moves, hides or deletes it (not the last of its state); + Column adds one; "N hidden" shows them again; the whole menu shows over the board, however short the board

The tree shows workstreams › stories (criteria m / n, due) › tasks and questions, decisions and risks at the story's level, with statuses (to do, answered, handled, no response, held, waiting…; blocked wins over waiting, as on the board)
"To review" lists suggested merges and moves (Yes / No) and weak "done"s ("Is X done?")

A card or row opens the Details drawer: id, kind, Send to Claude (tasks, stories, questions), the title (click to edit), thread › story path, the description or a record's Answer / Decision / Response (Markdown, Add / edit, ⌘S)
Details → Status changes the state (to do, in progress, blocked, done or held, cancelled; a question open / answered); History says "you set state · undo" and `echoctl project tasks` shows it

Details edits Owner, Handed over by, Due, Decided by, Likelihood and Impact as fit the kind (Owner, Handed over by and Decided by suggest Me and the thread's people as they are typed); criteria are ticked in "Done when · m of n"; a date box is saved once — typed, on Enter or when left; picked in its calendar, at once — and a date outside 2000–2100 is refused (by the ledger too)
Details → Who does it switches Claude can / By hand (Echo's guess shown faded) with its How or what Claude hands back

History lists the user's edits (each with undo) and the sync's entries with quote, speaker, source (a call's moment opens the call, a mail opens Outlook) and mark (verified, weak, wrong, to check, kept yours); undo restores the value before
Waits for, Holds up and Waiting on link to those items; Copy link gives `echo://task/<thread>/<id>`

"Link to an item in another thread" finds open items by title or id; Same work · done there / done here, or depends; a mirror shows its master's status, owner and due; Unlink undoes both sides; a thread's sync is told another thread's linked items (their ids, titles, thread) only when that thread is on the same AI profile — one pinned to another (or unknown) is only counted, and a mirror of its item shows no owner or what it waits for, only its state, due and since when it waits
A field the user set is never overwritten by a later sync: the call's words are kept in history as "kept yours"

A call, chat or mail in several threads is read by each thread's sync for that thread only: `pending` lists the other threads it is in (by name those on the same AI profile, the rest counted), `context` gives the thread's brief and terms to judge by, the extractor takes only what concerns this thread, and the verifier's packets carry the thread and `also_in` so a quote about another thread's work is judged wrong
